decisions.reason: Because it is close to the firm's online shop hosting core and was publicly recommended, management is inclined to keep it to avoid writing off that visible commitment.
Little has been invested and it only received a brief website mention, so it can be dropped quietly without significant loss or justification.
Premium support is central to the announced expansion of tailored support, so persistence is justified despite limited public commitment.
Its own page and fit with the established management tools reflect substantial investment and commitment, making withdrawal unlikely.
Although distant from the core, the dedicated page and multiple models represent visible investment that management would be reluctant to abandon.
